content.rendered:
Take your tastebuds on a journey to the spice capital of the world with this tantalising neighbourhood restaurant…

Introducing Inji.

Located on Birmingham Road, Sutton Coldfield, Inji is the exciting restaurant bringing Kerala’s spices to Sutton Coldfield.

The perfect mix of upscale and casual, this brilliant restaurant is all about making the every day exciting by bringing big flavours and exquisite spices to Sutton Coldfield’s diners. Inspired by Kerala cuisine and the abundance of fragrant spices that are found in the southern Indian state, this restaurant is offering its diners the opportunity to indulge in mouth-watering dishes each time they visit.

Kerala, often hailed as the spice capital of the world, is renowned for its rich cultural tapestry and gastronomic delights, boasting a rich culinary history involving a diverse array of seafood, meats and vegetables. At Inji, the chefs expertly create an array of dishes representing the various regions of Kerala, each painstakingly crafted to showcase the region’s culinary diversity.

On the menu at this wonderful restaurant you’ll find a wide range of delicious dishes, with something to please every palate. Veggies and vegans will feel just as at home here as meat-eaters and the vibrant array of flavourful plates of food are just as eye-catching as they are mouth-watering. They even have a lighter lunch menu so you can grab some tasty bites without facing a heavy meal, including Kerala tacos and spiced fries. Kerala cuisine has a strong connection with coconuts, so unsurprisingly you’ll find this delicious flavour in lots of their dishes from coconut based curries to coconut rice.

For starters you’ll find dishes such as Chilli Lentil Prawns, Curry Leaf Halloumi, Inji Chicken Wings and Keralan Fried Whitebait, each as perfectly spiced as the last. Mouth-watering mains include Alleppy Prawn Mango Curry, Kerala Beef Coconut Fry and Travancore Vegetable Curry, with sides such as Ghee Rice, Lentil and Spinach Dal, Paal Kappa and more. With desserts such as spiced brownies and a creamy Chai Brulee, there’s something to satisfy your sweet tooth here too. If you’ve never tried Kerala cuisine, then this is the perfect place to indulge in the delights of this southern Indian cuisine and discover some new and exciting flavours.

On the drinks menu you’ll find a selection of delicious drinks chosen to compliment those vibrant flavours. From beers and wines to hand-crafted cocktails and soft drinks, there’s something for everyone. Their house cocktails are inspired by Kerala flavours with options such as Mango Collada (tequila, passionfruit liqueur, pineapple), Old Fashioned – Inji Special (whiskey, rum, ginger) and Morning Blossom (strawberry tequila, mastica, lychee liqueur), with non-alcoholic cocktail options available too. With a selection of beers on draught and by the bottle, alongside red, rose, white and sparkling wines and a selection of spirits, you’ll certainly find your preferred beverage here.

The interior at Inji is relaxed luxury with leather bench seating, beautiful houseplants and fun neons all giving a comfortable and casual atmosphere with a touch of decadence. Exposed brick walls and woven chairs and tables give the space a more modern feel, and there’s even an outdoor terrace to enjoy in the warmer months. The perfect place to grab some delicious food on any day of the week, or to celebrate a special occasion in a laid-back environment, this awesome restaurant does it all. If you’re in the mood to treat your tastebuds to some unique and vibrant flavours, then a trip to Inji is on the cards.

Now offering Independent Birmingham App Members: 50% off food when you book a table at 5pm (everyday) or 25% off the bill (Monday – Thursday, 12pm – 5pm) or 10% off the bill (anytime)

content.rendered:
Delicious Indian cuisine, in a super luxurious setting.

Introducing Dil Se.

Located in The Mailbox, Dil Se is the contemporary Indian restaurant where flavour and luxury combine to give you a memorable dining experience.

Dil Se means ‘from the heart’ – a sentiment that is reflected in everything they do at this fantastic restaurant. Everything has been designed from the heart, the service is heartfelt, and each dish is cooked with love and precision to ensure the best dining experience every time. You can expect a memorable meal on every visit.

Drawing inspiration from Sri Lanka and South India, the menu has been designed to reflect the fresh ingredients, flavours and style of cooking in these regions. Cooking and eating are simple pleasures, bringing people together which is what the team at Dil Se are aiming to do – bring guests together to enjoy some mouth-watering food and drinks. Their belief that food should be made ‘from the heart’ influences everything they do and the team’s love for food and hospitality shines through.

The ambition at Dil Se is to showcase high quality Indian food through a fusion of South and North Indian dishes. South Indian cuisine is predominantly plant-based including lots of vegetables, legumes and whole grains (making it a little bit healthier if that’s your thing, but no less delicious). Coconut is used in lots of dishes as well as gluten free flour so there are lots of veggie, vegan and gluten free options making sure everyone can enjoy this delicious food.

On the menu you’ll find a range of delicious starters from light nibbles (such as papadoms or masala peanuts) to Chaats, and veggie, meat and seafood small plates. Start your delicious meal with the likes of Chilli Paneer, Vada Pav (a spicy potato patty in a bun with chutneys), Butter Chicken Wings, Kashmiri Chicken Tikka, Lamb Sheek Kebab, Tandoori Jumbo King Prawn and more. Or, if you can’t decide, grab one of their mixed platters to try a selection of mouth-watering dishes.

For mains you’ll find a selection of crowd-pleasers and comforting dishes from Dosa (a savoury crispy crepe with a choice of fillings) and Uttapam (a thick and soft savoury crepe with various fillings) to veggie and meat curries, seafood dishes, Biryani and some Indo-Chinese fusion dishes. Whether you choose the Pan Fried Masala Sea Bass or the Saag Chicken, the Kachhi Mirch Ka Lamb or the Palak Paneer, each dish is cooked with the expertise to ensure it is delicious every time. Every dish is packed full of flavour.

In addition to their regular menu, Dil Se also offer an Indian-inspired Afternoon Tea and a Bombay Bottomless Brunch – for those looking to indulge in style.

To accompany your delicious dishes, they have an extensive drinks menu with an option for everyone to enjoy. Enjoy a selection of red, rose, white and sparkling wines, beers, ciders and soft drinks, and even thick, creamy milkshakes (in flavours such as Oreo, Ferrero Rocher and Mango – yes please). They also offer a range of house cocktails and mocktails. From classics like Pina Colada, Mojitos and Passionfruit Martinis to more unique concoctions like Mumbai Mango Mule, Banana and Nutella Martini, and Strawberry Watermelon Margarita, there’s something for everyone to enjoy! Their mocktails are just as tasty with the likes of Mango Colada and non-alcoholic Mojitos making the ideal accompaniment to your meal.

Found in one of Birmingham’s more up-market settings, The Mailbox, Dil Se is perfectly at home in this swanky setting. With luxe interiors and elegant details, the interior is reflective of the brand’s vibe and makes this restaurant the perfect place to celebrate a special occasion. But that’s not to say that you can’t enjoy a meal here without celebrating, you’ll feel just at home here whatever the occasion thanks to the friendly staff and beautiful setting (and, of course, the delicious food).

content.rendered:
If you go down to the woods today, you’re sure of a big surprise…

Ok, technically not actually deep in the woods, but that’s how it feels visiting this particular independent. Housed in an iconic wooden tree-house style building, surrounded by a little woodland clearing with wooden picnic benches, this is truly a hidden gem. You’d be forgiven for thinking you’d stumbled into a fairy tale when you visit this beautiful little bakery.

Introducing Silver Tree Bakery.

Located on Water Orton Lane, Sutton Coldfield, Silver Tree Bakery is the magical little bakery where you can enjoy equally magical (and delicious) baked goods.

It’s no secret that we here at Indy-B LOVE our baked goods. Seriously, we can’t get enough of them. Breads, pastries, cakes, buns, sausage rolls – the list goes on. We want it all. So when we come across an outstanding bakery serving up the most delicious baked goods, we can’t keep it to ourselves – that would be mean. That’s why we want to introduce you to Silver Tree Bakery.

At Silver Tree Bakery, they have over 20 years of industry experience, giving them the knowledge, expertise and skills to lovingly create the most incredible baked goods. All of their delicious breads, cakes, pastries and savouries are baked fresh each and every day in-house using the finest and most locally-sourced ingredients they can get their hands on. Nothing beats truly freshly baked goods, and you can tell that so much love and care has gone into their delicious bakes.

Inside the bakery you will find all manner of baked goodies, from beautiful, hand-crafted sourdough loaves to flaky, buttery croissants and profiteroles bursting with cream to freshly-baked sausage rolls. Muffins, cakes, cinnamon buns, custard tarts – the list goes on, and each one is just as delicious as the last. Try something new each time you visit or keep coming back for your favourites. Either way, you’re winning.

As well as the amazing, freshly-baked goods to take away, you can also stay and enjoy some tasty sandwiches, toasties, cakes and coffee on site. Look out for the daily specials too if you want to try something different each visit. Grab a coffee, tea or hot chocolate, and catch up with a friend over a tasty bite to eat, and then take some baked goods home with you to enjoy too. It’s the perfect scenario.

The bakery itself is found just off Water Orton Lane and is a truly magical little venue. No matter what season you visit, the bakery looks stunning with it’s timber A-frame providing an iconic silhouette against the clear skies. But we think the bakery truly comes alive in the winter. Nothing beats seeing the wooden hut adorned with decorations and twinkling lights, glowing on a dark wintery day, as the smell of freshly baked bread wafts over you in clouds, inviting you in to devour the tempting delights inside. It doesn’t get better than that!

If you’re as obsessed with baked goods as we are (or you just fancy a delicious treat at a magical little bakery), then a trip to Silver Tree Bakery is an absolute must.

Now offering Independent Birmingham Members: Any hot drink and pastry/bun for just £4.50 (Wednesday – Friday) + 10% off the bill (Saturday – Sunday)

content.rendered:
Japanese tradition meets modern culinary artistry.

Intrigued? Read on to find out more.

Introducing Satori.

Located on St Mary’s Row, Moseley, Satori is the elevated Japanese restaurant that has foodies flocking to the suburbs.

The Japanese concept of ‘Satori’ (a moment of awakening or enlightenment) is the inspiration behind this wonderful restaurant where they aim to offer a dining experience that transcends the ordinary. Every dish at this fantastic restaurant is painstakingly crafted to enliven the senses and spark profound enjoyment, leaving a lasting impression on every guest who dines there.

At Satori, the finest ingredients are combined with masterful techniques to guide you through an unforgettable journey through Japanese cuisine. The menu offers all manner of delights from delicate sushi and sashimi platters to premium A5 Wagyu beef and perfectly grilled seafood. Thier signature Miso Black Cod is a taste sensation, and they offer a selection of creative vegetarian options too, such as Tea Smoked Aubergine. There’s something for everyone on the menu and each and every bite is packed full of flavour, freshness and refinement.

These dishes don’t just taste amazing, they’re also beautifully presented. Satori know that diners eat with their eyes first so all of their dishes have been honed to ensure perfect presentation each and every time. In fact, the devil is in the details and these dishes often resemble works of art, many presented on kintsugi-inspired plates. The Japanese art of kintsugi fixes broken pottery with gold to celebrate the beauty of imperfection and resilience – a metaphor for Satori’s approach to food and dining: embracing the traditional whilst also appreciating the beauty in uniqueness.

At Satori they offer both A La Carte dining and tasting menus, so you can choose the dining experience that suits you. Whichever style of menu you choose, they are all filled with amazing dishes made with the best ingredients and lovingly prepared by the talented chefs. There’s also the option to add a drinks pairing (with a choice of wine, cocktail or Sake pairing) when you opt for the tasting menu if you wish to elevate your experience a little more too.

The mouth-watering food is perfectly complemented by a stellar drinks offering, carefully curated to ensure quality and diversity – making sure there is something for everyone to enjoy. From signature Japanese-inspired cocktails to a selection of Sake, a curated wine list and non-alcoholic cocktails there are plenty of delicious options to choose from.

Satori is about more than just the food – it’s about the experience. The ambience, the service and the atmosphere are all part of the overall dining experience and so all play their part. The space itself is designed to be an oasis of calm, with luxe details lending themselves to special occasions, whilst also being casual enough for a midweek meal. Designed to be the perfect mix of modern elegance and warm hospitality, they want every diner to feel relaxed and at home.

If you’re yet to visit this wonderful Japanese restaurant, we highly recommend you book a table and treat your tastebuds to a meal to remember.

content.rendered:
Saturday afternoons (or, you know, Wednesday lunchtimes if you’re a wildcard like us) are the perfect time to immerse yourself in a full cinematic experience.

We love nothing more than spending a few hours diving into another world and escaping into an engaging story told through an incredible cinematic voyage. The cinema is one of the nation’s favourite pastimes, and there’s nothing quite like seeing an epic new movie (or old favourite) on the big screen. Combine this with delicious snacks and drink, and you’re onto a winning combination. Let us regale you with tales of a brilliant independent cinema right on your doorsteps.

Introducing The Mockingbird Cinema and Bar.

Located just a stone’s throw from the city centre, in the iconic Custard Factory in Digbeth, The Mockingbird Cinema and Bar is your new go-to destination for movies old and new.

The Mockingbird Cinema is a fully independent cinema, meaning not only are they not part of a big chain, but they also hand-pick the films that they showcase, without influence and direction from big cinema chains and movie companies. This means they are free to choose the films that they want to show and think their audience will enjoy the most. So, in their listings expect to see some new, exciting blockbusters but also a whole load of classics and old favourites. And themed events, let’s not forget them – taking place throughout the year, there are moveie and wine events, movie marathons, special guest Q&As, celebrity meet and greet events and more. Nicely done Mockingbird. 

Let’s talk snacks. No trip to the cinema would be complete without some epic snacks. It doesn’t get better than mouthfuls of delicious popcorn when it comes to the ideal movie snack, and naturally they have popcorn on offer at The Mockingbird. But you can also grab some tasty sweets to tide you over during the film, or if you prefer something savoury they have crisps too. Perfect!

Not only is this a working cinema, but you can even hire it our for private events. Ever wanted to hire out a movie screen just for you and your mates? Or have you wanted to celebrate your birthday in style with a private movie screening? Looking for your office’s next team-building activity? Look no further than the Mockingbird. Their cinema room can be rented out for private events and functions to provide you with a fun and memorable experience like no other. They have 2 screens to choose from; a 90- seat screen and a 30- seat screen, and to make the experience extra special, they can provide your party with delicious food and drink. You’ll be hailed an office hero. Well played you, well played.

Now offering Independent Birmingham Members: 2-for-1 tickets (Monday – Thursday, when purchased at the venue) or 10% off tickets (Friday – Sunday, when purchased at the venue) + 10% off food and drink (anytime)

content.rendered:
We’re not short of coffee shops in Birmingham, and it feels as though the coffee offering in the city gets better all the time. If you’re looking for a new coffee shop to add to your regular rotation, allow us to guide you in the direction of the Jewellery Quarter…

Introducing Besa.

Located on Ludgate Hill in the Jewellery Quarter, Besa is the coffee shop delivering comfort in every sip.

At Besa you’re invited to take a break, sip a delicious drink and savour the moment. Besa is an ancient word dating back to the Bronze Age from the area now recognised as Albania. Besa means ‘honour’ or ‘promise’ – a quiet promise of trust and care, carried through small actions and meaningful gestures. The team at this wonderful coffee shop have woven that into every aspect of their business, with a promise to deliver on service and quality each time you visit, through consistency, attention and warmth. They want to welcome you in like an old friend and help you to relax for a while.

Inspired by the historic area in which they have made their home, Besa draws on the heritage and craftsmanship of the area to inspire all that they do. Just like the craftspeople who came before them, they strive to create something meaningful – not just a cup of coffee, but a feeling.

With this in mind, each and every drink on their menu is thoughtfully crafted, from a simple Espresso to a velvety flat white, and everything in between. It’s not just coffee on the menu, as you can also enjoy everything from rich and creamy hot chocolates to vibrant matcha lattes, comforting chai and more. All of their drinks can be made iced too (perfect for the summer months).

If you’re looking for something refreshing on your visit, they also offer a range of delicious smoothies with flavours to suit all tastes. Whether you opt for the fruity ‘Berry Go Round’ smoothie featuring strawberries, blackberries and raspberries or the healthy ‘Avo Go-Go’ packed with nutrients thanks to the mango, spinach, broccoli, avocado, coconut, lime and ginger, you’ll be in for a cooling, flavour-packed drink.

For those looking for something a little different, Besa have an experimental range too featuring the likes of: JQ mont blanc (iced Americano with in-house marmalade syrup and cold foam), matcha delight (fresh fruit milk topped with matcha and a secret cold foam), sunshine shake (a wake-up slushie of coconut milk, turmeric, honey and condensed milk). Perfect for those looking to try something new and exciting.

If you’re feeling peckish, they stock a range of mouth-watering sweet treats to enjoy alongside your favourite drink. Their cookies are a big hit, and they change up the flavours regularly with lots of tasty options to try – think Apple Crumble, Lemon Meringue Pie, Fig and Caramel, Toffee Pecan Chocolate Chip and lots more. Browse the selection of cookies on the day and pick up one of these tasty treats for a seriously tasty treat.

As well as their delicious cookies, they offer a selection of other baked goods including an ever-changing selection of cakes and bakes. Enjoy everything from Estonia Honey Cake and Earl Grey Lemon Curd Muffins to Blueberry Basque Cheesecake and House Espresso Brownies. With so many delicious options to try, you’ll have to keep coming back for more.

In addition to tasty baked goods and cookies, Besa also stock 3 dangerously moreish rolls for you to enjoy alongside your chosen beverage: a pork sausage roll, a spinach and feta roll (yum!) or a vegan sausage roll. Available while stocks last (we’ve heard they go quickly), if you fancy something a little more filling to keep your delicious drink company, make sure you grab one pronto!

The space itself is cosy and welcoming with a mix of industrial design details such as pendant lighting, and comfy upholstered bench seating with marble effect tables. There’s plenty of seating for enjoying your delicious drinks and baked goods, but you can always take your order to go if you’re in a rush. Make sure to stop by this brilliant coffee shop and add it to your rotation of favourite coffee stops in the city.

Now offering Independent Birmingham App members: Coffee from the main menu + a roll for £8 OR 10% off the bill

content.rendered:
We are truly blessed in Birmingham with a plethora of cuisines from around the globe, so you’re never too far from your next delicious meal.

This restaurant is a popular favourite for a reason, so allow us to guide you in the direction of this fantastic independent serving some of the tastiest dishes in Brum.

Introducing Store 9.

Located on Hurst Street, Chinatown, Store 9 is the Cantonese Restaurant offering an authentic taste of Hong Kong.

Store 9 is an authentic Cantonese restaurant found in the heart of Birmingham and specialising in Cantonese roast meats. So if you love the likes of a Triple Roast (if you’ve never had one it’s a mouth-watering combo of roast duck, char siu pork, and crispy pork belly served on a bed of fluffy rice), this place is an absolute must for some of the most delicious roast meats you’ll find in Brum.

All of the roast meats are freshly prepared using time-honoured techniques to achieve rich flavour, juicy meats and perfectly crispy skin. There really is nothing better, and we highly recommend you go try these delicious meats for yourself.

Alongside their signature roast meats, you’ll also find other popular Hong Kong and Cantonese dishes such as Wontons Noodle Soup, Singapore Fried Vermicelli, Curry Fish Balls, Salted Duck Egg, Salt and Pepper Fries and lots more. Even if you’re not in the mood for roast meats there are plenty of tempting dishes to try, whatever your tastebuds are craving.

As well as their mouth-watering roast meats, they’re also known for their incredible Hong Kong desserts. These popular sweet treats like their French Toast (which is perfectly golden and fluffy with a hidden surprise of peanut butter in the middle) and Pineapple Bun are fun and tasty, and you can’t miss the refreshing Mango Pomelo Sago (a creamy and delicious mango drink made with mango puree, pomelo pulp and coconut milk) – the perfect way to finish your meal.

This place is a wonderful casual eatery, where you can grab a quick bite to eat or have a more leisurely meal with warm and friendly service and laid-back vibes. The decor is very much in a canteen style, very casual, and they even have a corner where guests can play Mahjong whilst they wait, adding to the relaxed, community vibe. If you’re looking for authentic, Hong Kong-style comfort food then this is the place to go.

content.rendered:
One thing we love here at Independent Birmingham, is a success story.

When we hear of street food traders who’ve risen in popularity to the point they can open their very own permanent venue, it brings a smile to our faces.

Introducing Cafe Kibo.

Located on Bristol Road South, Longbridge, Cafe Kibo is the East Asian inspired cafe from the popular street food trader, Hope You’re Hungry.

The fantastic Hope You’re Hungry has been serving up some of the tastiest street food dishes on the circuit for the last few years, growing in popularity and making a name for themselves with their delicious East Asian inspired eats. From bao to award-winning wings, and lots more in between, they’ve produced some of the tastiest dishes around.

Now, they’ve taken the leap to open their very own place – an East Asian inspired coffee shop and street food cafe called Cafe Kibo. This wonderful cafe serves all manner of tasty treats from bubble tea and proper coffee to bao, Japanese sandos and more! If you love Asian flavours, then this place needs to be high up on your to visit list.

The menu at Cafe Kibo is packed full of big hitting, crowd-pleasing, street food favourites. So whether you turn up for breakfast and enjoy a delicious speciality coffee alongside a mouth-watering breakfast Sando (yep, it’s as delicious as it sounds) or you head over for a seriously tasty lunch and grab yourself a Katsu curry, a selection of bao, and more – there’s always something truly delicious on the menu for you to enjoy.

The breakfast menu features some tasty dishes that are sure to set you up for the day. Choose from a bao or a sando (made using beautiful Shokupan bread – so it’s a proper sando) and then select your choice of fillings (think bacon, sausage or both, with egg and cheese, or veggie/vegan sausage). Add a side of mini hash browns to take your breakfast up an extra notch (trust us, always add the hash browns) and you’ll be starting your day the right way. Perfect paired with one of their delicious coffees (made using Quarter Horse beans).

On the lunchtime menu, you’ll find bao and sando again (with optional chips on the side), this time with a choice of Asian inspired fillings such as pork belly, fried chicken (with a choice of sauce) or crispy tofu. For the evening, there’s a choice of bao, rice bowls and Katsu dishes – all served with a choice of delicious Asian-inspired flavours and ingredients. The food is the stuff of your street food dreams, served in a cosy cafe setting for the ultimate casual feast.

The cafe itself is small and cosy with a mix of tables and bar-style seating. The light and airy décor gives a bright feel to the space with pops of pink and green in-keeping with Cafe Kibo’s signature branding. This is a lovely, welcoming space to enjoy some light bites, packed with flavour and cooked with love. Go check them out now.

content.rendered:
Sometimes you just need a hug in a mug.

That’s exactly what you’ll find at this brilliant independent…

Located on Stratford Road, Shirley, Bora Coffee is the independent coffee shop offering comfort in every cup.

At Bora Coffee they take their beans as seriously as their atmosphere – making sure each and every brew is cosy and comforting, just like the space they’ve curated. They want all of their guests to feel at home so they’ve designed the space to be calm and relaxing, a comfortable place to take a break.

The coffees at Bora Coffee are all made using carefully selected beans. Their signature Bora Blend combines coffees from Ethiopia and Rwanda to create a smooth and distinctive cup with fruity, winey, and sweet flavour notes. Alongside this signature blend they also offer a selection of single-origin coffees, including beans originating from Indonesia, Guatemala, and more. So whether you’re knocking back an espresso or sipping on a flat white, you know that your coffee has been carefully considered and created with the care and attention it deserves.

To bring out the best of their unique selection of coffee, they like to use manual brewing methods such as V60 and Chemex. All of the coffee blends at Bora Coffee are also available to purchase as beans in-store, so if you want to up your coffee game at home, you can pick up your favourote blend when you visit. They can even grind them fresh for you, ready to be used in whatever brewing method you use at home.

If you’re not a coffee person, or you simply fancy a change, they have plenty of other delicious drinks on the menu too. So whether you fancy a warming cup of tea or an indulgent milkshake, there’s something for everyone. Refreshing fruit smoothies and tasty frappes are available too – perfect for when the weather is a little warm and you need something to cool you down.

You won’t just find drinks at this neighbourhood coffee shop though, you’ll also find lots of delicious food options to get stuck into too. Their popular Bora Breakfast Bagel is a smash hit featuring streaky bacon, egg, cheese and crispy onions, as well as their Bora Breakfast. You can also enjoy Toasted Teacake, Bora Granola Bowl, a stack of Pancakes with a choice of toppings, loaded Jacket Potatoes, toasted sandwiches and lots more too. They have a daily selection of cakes too, with vegan and gluten free options too – so there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

As an independent, they’re keen to share the indie love, so Bora Coffee partner with local suppliers to ensure everything is fresh and high quality, from their farm fresh eggs to locally baked bread and cakes from local bakers.

If you’re yet to visit, make sure to stop by and discover a new favourite local coffee stop.

content.rendered:
Birmingham is the home of many things. But one of the most famous (and delicious) is the Balti.

Introducing Shababs.

Located on Ladypool Road, Shababs is one of Birmingham’s very best Indian restaurants and a pioneer of the Balti.

When it comes to the Birmingham Balti, it doesn’t get much more legendary than Shababs. One of the most prestigious of the pioneers of the famous curry which was developed and honed in Birmingham’s Balti Triangle, if you’re looking to hit the streets of Brum in search of the best Balti around, then direct your steps towards Shababs.

Originally founded in 1987, Shababs is a veteran of Birmingham’s Balti scene and one of the best places to enjoy a true, authentic Balti. The Balti is cooked in the same dish it is served in, with the cast iron Balti pans being used over and over, each time improving the flavour of the dish. Cooked over a high flame, this delicious curry is packed full of flavour and heat and is an absolute must for your Birmingham bucket list.

There’s no better place to sample the delights of this Brummie staple than at Shababs, one of the few remaining authentic Balti houses. Order one of their delicious, soft, fluffy naans to scoop up all of those mouth-watering flavours for the ultimate curry expeirence. Trust us, you won’t regret it.

Of course, there’s more to Shababs than just their exceptional Baltis (although that is what they’re famous for) and for those of you who fancy branching out from the Balti there are lots of equally tasty dishes on their menu for you to sample too. From Bhuna to Korma, to Biryani, Jalfreezi and Rogan Josh, you’ll find all of your favourite curries here – all cooked with passion using traditional techniques and recipes for mouth-watering, authentic flavours. Whatever you choose, it’s sure to leave you full and satisfied with a great big smile on your face. The table naans are enormous and an absolute must to mop all of those lovely, rich flavours and leave your plates sparkling clean (because you’ll want to eat every last tasty morsel).

The restaurant interior has everything you want from a classic Balti restaurant with a modern edge. A mix of luxury details and a laid-back atmosphere – but let’s face it you’re here for the food not the décor! You’ll feel relaxed and welcome at Shababs and you’ll leave with full bellies and happy hearts.

The fact that Shababs has been open for over 35 years is testament to their delicious food and excellent service. They pride themselves on providing an exceptional service for their guests and have many repeat customers who keep coming back for more because of it. If you’re looking to try a true, authentic Birmingham Balti then a trip to Shababs is an absolute must.

content.rendered:
Food, drinks, music and VIBES. This place has it all.

Introducing Stir Stores.

Located on Pershore Road, Stirchley, Stir Stores is a funky bar and neon artwork shop.

Stir Stores is more than just a bar, it’s a whole vibe. This bright and vibrant neighbourhood hangout is a great place to enjoy some downtime and have fun. With more than one string to their bow, this place is a bar, a place to grab a bite to eat, a place to enjoy some funky tunes, and a place to browse some delightful collectibles (and add a few to your collection, of course).

Adding some colour and style to Stirchley’s cohort of fabulous independents, this place is going to become your new favourite hangout. Their “neon lodge” is as fun as it is colourful and something different to all of the minimal spaces of recent years. If minimal isn’t your thing, you’ll love this place.

This brilliant bar (and eatery and shop and live music venue) is all about bringing a fun vibe to Pershore Road and is the ideal place to unwind after a long day – kick back and have some fun. They serve a range of drinks to suit all tastes, from cocktails (including everyone’s fave, Espresso Martinis) to craft beers and wine.

As well as being a great little bar and hangout, Stir Stores also offers a curated menu of delicious bites to eat. Their current food menu is full of Middle Eastern-inspired delights. Think hummus and flatbreads, hot fuuls, halloumi bites, cod fritters, hearty soups, baklava and lots more yummy things. The small plates are perfect for sharing so grab a few different plates for the table and dig in with your companions for a tasty feast.

Yet another fun aspect of this brilliant venue is their frequent events and especially DJ evenings and live music performances. They regularly host open mic nights, quizzes, one-off gigs and special events. Perfect for enjoying some amazing live music and taking your evening out up a notch. Check out their social media pages for all of the upcoming events you won’t want to miss out on.

The Stir Stores pop-up shop stocks all manner of fun homeware just waiting for you to deck out your house. From furniture and artwork to their specialty: neons. There’s something for all tastes, and what could be more fun than browsing for some fun pieces for your home while you sip on a drink or two at this lovely venue.

So, if you’re looking for an awesome place to hangout and have a great time, Stir Stores is the place that has it all. Swing by and visit them for your next night out.

content.rendered:
Not all tacos are created equal.

Introducing A La Mexicana.

Located on Sandon Road, Bearwood, A La Mexicana is the authentic Mexican restaurant bringing the heat to Bearwood’s streets.

A La Mexicana have been a firm favourite of foodies in the know ever since they opened, and with good reason. If you’ve somehow missed the memo then this is your sign to book yourself a table and discover for yourself the mouth-watering flavours of Mexico at this fantastic, family-run restaurant.

At A La Mexicana, they like to keep things simple. But simple doesn’t mean boring. It just means that there’s nothing on the plate that doesn’t need to be there. The flavours and recipes are authentic, passed down through generations of the family (who own and operate this brilliant eatery together). The focus is on the food, and the flavours are immense. If you love tacos and Mexican food, you really can’t go wrong with a trip to this wonderful restaurant. You won’t find more authentic Mexican dishes anywhere else in Brum.

On the menu you’ll find a selection of Mexican favourites from Nachos and Huevos Rancheros to Tortillas, Tacos and Tostadas. Everything is made fresh in the restaurant using authentic ingredients for maximum taste and enjoyment. We might be biased (because we have an overwhelming weakness for tacos) but the tacos here really are the star of the show. The tortillas are made fresh each day and hand pressed (not a sad, limp, Old El Paso in sight), and the toppings are all packed with flavour – each one distinct and delicious. If you love tacos as much as us, then they are an absolute must, and there are lots of flavours to choose from (such as chicken tinga, chorizo, carnitas, birria and more).

Of course, whatever you try is just as delicious and their homemade nachos are the perfect start to your feast, and for the hungry ones among you, we recommend trying out some of their mains (as well as tacos, of course). Freshly made burritos, enchiladas or specials such as pork ribs in adobo sauce, or mole enchiladas, are all just as delicious and there are so many different dishes for you to try on each visit. To top it all off, they offer some truly incredible desserts too. The desserts are always made fresh and regularly change but you can usually find some flavour of cheesecake (think Mango, Oreo, or even Rice Pudding flavour).

To accompany your delicious food, you’ll need some equally delicious drinks. Whether you choose to quench your thirst on a Margarita or two (it’d be rude not to, right?), a Sol beer, or a Jarritos (authentic Mexican soft drinks) there’s always the perfect accompaniment to be found on their drinks menu. Naturally they have a great selection of Tequilas and Mezcals and some tasty cocktails too.

The restaurant itself is laid-back and casual, with nods to the family’s Mexican heritage throughout the décor (Sombreros on the walls, Mexican flag bunting, and more). With wooden tables and chairs and bright orange walls, this is a fun and vibrant place to enjoy a casual bite to eat. You won’t find glitz and glamour here, but you will find truly delicious and authentic food (and that’s what it’s all about).

Whether you pop in for a glorious lunch or you have a leisurely evening feast, the service is always so warm and friendly (you really feel like part of the family) and the food is always delicious. If you’re yet to experience this little slice of Mexico in Brum, then make sure to grab yourself a table immediately and go enjoy some of the best Mexican food of your life. You can thank us later.

content.rendered:
Location, location, location.

This gastropub has it in buckets.

Introducing The Bracebridge.

Located in the picturesque Sutton Park, The Bracebridge is chef Andrew Sheridan’s showcase lakeside pub.

Locations don’t get much better than this for a gastropub, and the location itself is a glorious reason to visit this exciting foodie hotspot. Set on the banks of Bracebridge Pool in the heart of Sutton Park, this beautiful pub boasts some spectacular views, making it the ideal setting for all of your gatherings and the perfect place to enjoy some delicious food and drinks, basking in the glow of summer sunshine. But regardless of the season, this is a beautiful setting for a bite to eat (just as stunning in the winter as it is in the summer).

At The Bracebridge they’re all about taking British pub classics and elevating them to a new level, bringing a touch of sophistication, elegance and quality produce to these nostalgic dishes. You’ll find a range of classic pub snacks, starters, mains (including some amazing dairy steaks) and crowd-pleasing puddings, with something for everyone to enjoy.

The main menu includes pub classics such as fish and chips, sausage and mash and a fish finger sandwich, alongside more elevated, contemporary dishes such as hand-dived scallops or Wiltshire truffle gnocchi. From the grill you can enjoy a delicious Welsh dairy steak (for one, or for two to share) along with mouth-watering dishes such as spiced monkfish tail or soy caramel middle white pork chop. Whatever dish you choose, you can be safe in the knowledge that the very best ingredients have been used and cooked with love and care by the talented chefs.

Any pub worth their salt offers a great roast, so naturally on a Sunday you can enjoy a delicious roast at The Bracebridge, featuring a choice of meats, fish or veggie option. All are served family-style to the table with all the trimmings (think Yorkshire pudding, cauliflower cheese, roast potatoes and gravy) and all are absolutely delicious. We can’t think of a more beautiful setting to enjoy a delicious Sunday roast.

For those of you with a sweet tooth who like to end their meal with a sumptuous dessert, you won’t be disappointed. Just as with the rest of their menu, here they offer a selection of nostalgic puddings with an elevated twist. Think along the lines of sherry coconut trifle, sticky toffee pudding and chocolate tart. The menus change to reflect the seasons but you will always find classic pub dishes with a twist that will leave you satisfied and sure to come back again and again.

The drinks menu has been carefully selected to compliment the food and to ensure that every guest can find something they’ll enjoy. From a lovely selection of wines to a range of spirits, a number of beers on draught (and by the can or bottle), as well as soft drinks and hot drinks, there’s a good range of options for everyone. Pop next door to their on-site bakery and tap house, The Sip and Slice, for a take-away coffee (and a cheeky pastry) as you stroll through the glorious surroundings of Sutton Park.

The pub itself is just as comforting and cosy as the food, with the classic gastropub feel of elevated casual, to perfectly reflect the menus. The crowning glory though is the terrace, which is the ideal place to enjoy an al fresco lunch with a stunning backdrop of the water and the forests surrounding the pub. A truly unique and delightful location for a memorable meal. The interior is stunning, with plush, green velvet sofas, rattan chairs and wooden tables giving a modern, elevated feel to the décor.

content.rendered:
There’s nothing we love more than a great coffee shop.

Except maybe a great coffee shop that serves epic desserts and happens to look beautiful too. You could say this place is the whole package.

Introducing Ocha.

Located on Hurst Street, Chinatown, Ocha is the aesthetically pleasing coffee shop serving premium speciality coffees, matcha, and freshly made desserts.

This place brings the vibes. Truly immaculate coffee shop vibes. We’re not short of excellent coffee shops in Brum, but we are always happy to add yet another amazing option to our hit list, and let us tell you that this place will probably be going straight to the top of your favourite coffee shops list.

At Ocha they take their drinks seriously and serve up some of the very best coffees and speciality drinks in the city. From incredible flat whites and iced coffees (you know, the usual suspects but really, really good) to more unique options such as espresso tonic, strawberry matcha floats, watermelon coconut iced tea and more, there are some truly exciting drinks to be sipped at this lovely coffee shop. Go for your usual coffee order or branch out and try something new – either way the drinks are delicious, and with the stunning surrounds we bet you won’t be able to resist snapping a pic for your Instagram too.

You won’t just find drinks that will put a smile on your face at this fantastic little place. The team at Ocha also serve some heavenly pastries and desserts for you to get your sweet tooth cravings fix too, all made in-house. Think along the lines of crème brûlée Basque cheesecake, strawberry bingsu (shaved frozen milk with layers of crushed strawberries, on top of a layer of crunchy strawberry ice – sounds like a summer dream), pandan and mango cream cake, matcha banana bread, Oreo cheesecake brownies, and more! We’re not sure how you’ll choose between these mouth-watering options but if you get two or three to try, we certainly won’t judge (mostly because we’ll be doing the same).

The space itself is an aesthetic dream, with calming tonal colours creating an effortlessly cool and minimal coffee shop vibe. They really have nailed it with this one and we’re pretty sure it’s going to be one of the most popular coffee spots in Brum. The team behind Ocha have created an inviting space where guests can enjoy quality drinks and sweet treats whilst unwinding and taking some time to relax. The perfect place to meet friends for a catch up or enjoy a moment to yourself on a busy day. An oasis in the city. Plus they offer take-away too, so it’s a great place to stop by when you need a caffeine fix on the go!

So if you’re on the lookout for a new coffee shop to add to your roster, or you fancy trying some unique and exciting drinks and delicious sweet treats, then make sure to stop by Ocha to check them out!

content.rendered:
There’s something romantically nostalgic about wandering down to the neighbourhood bakery and eyeing up all of the beautiful cakes and bakes, before selecting your favourite to enjoy over a cup of tea or coffee.

Something which seems to have slipped by the wayside in recent times, but something we whole-heartedly think should be brought back into the light. Slow down, enjoy the moment, eat the cake. So, where can you go to get a freshly-baked cake in Birmingham?

Introducing The Early Bird Bakery.

Located on Kings Heath High Street, The Early Bird Bakery is an independent bakery and speciality coffee shop, specialising in fresh baked goods and delicious brunch.

If you’ve been looking for a brand new spot to sit and enjoy a seriously tasty brunch with friends, or sip on a coffee and munch on freshly baked cakes as you watch the world go by, then stop looking, you’ve found it. The Early Bird Bakery in Kings Heath is THE ideal place to fulfil all of your café needs.

Owners (and brothers) Tim and Joe and chef Tim met at the Birmingham Coffee Festival a few years ago. Chef Tim had travelled all over the world, working as a chef and a pastry chef in numerous countries, gaining a vast wealth of experience and inspiration. Wanting to use this knowledge and skills to create something special of his own, and after meeting Tim and Joe, the three decided that what Birmingham really lacks and needs is somewhere to buy truly fresh, delicious cakes. There aren’t many places in the city where you can eat a cake that has been made that morning, on the premises, with super fresh ingredients. This is what they set out to achieve.

Enter: The Early Bird Bakery. Having found their location in Kings Heath, they joined the ever-growing throng of indies opening their doors in the up-and-coming suburbs. Since opening their doors in November 2018 they’ve been quietly making waves with the locals, with their tempting bakes and scrumptious brunch dishes. They’re already full to the brim on weekends, and we’re sure they’re soon to receive cult brunch destination status.

The focus here is on high quality, fresh ingredients, with all of the food being made in-house each day. There aren’t many places in Birmingham where you can walk in, grab a coffee and a cake, and know that cake was baked right there, that morning. It’s a truly special thing to eat a freshly baked cake, and something we think is highly underrated. From traditional cakes with a twist, cruffins, muffins and all sorts of pastries – you can get it all. Creative baking at its finest.

At Early Bird Bakery, they also specialise in serving up fresh, exciting brunch dishes. We know you might be thinking, “brunch, how original?” right? But hear us out. This isn’t your standard avocado or poached eggs on toast type brunch. Sure, they have avocado on toast (but served with slow roasted tomatoes, pickled radish and their own dukkah spice, um hello), but they also offer other delights such as brioche with ginger-marinated bacon and sweet chilli jam, and mushrooms in toast (yes in, not on). If this brunch menu doesn’t spark you with excitement and lust, we think there might be something very wrong with you.

The piece-de-resistance on their brunch menu though is the heavenly cinnamon roll French toast. Born from a desire to reduce waste in the business (bravo, Early Bird), and not wanting to throw out any un-sold cinnamon rolls, this godly dish was designed. Light, fluffy cinnamon rolls, lovingly created into the most delicious French toast dish you’ve ever had the pleasure of putting in your mouth, served with burnt orange, mascarpone and pecan praline (oh, that pecan praline!). This is a dish that is 100% going to reach cult status and will have visitors flocking (pun intended) to Early Bird to devour it week after week. A truly spectacular and unique dish, we urge you to go try it for yourselves.

With a regularly changing brunch menu, to reflect the availability of ingredients and to keep things fresh and exciting (and reduce waste where possible), and a light, bright and welcoming café space, you’re sure to love it here. The brunch menu focuses on simple dishes, done well, with the freshest ingredients and the food is definitely the highlight of this great new indie. With speciality coffee from Hundred House Coffee (a Midlands based coffee roasters) and a selection of teas and hot chocolate, you’ll also find something tasty to accompany your food and quench your thirst. Oh,and we hear they knock up some banging lunches too. Really, you have no excuse not to visit. Go get your brunch on, and then grab a cake for the way home too. You know you want to.

content.rendered:
Tucked away under the arches of Moor Street Station is a hidden bar doing big things.

Introducing Kilder.

Located on Shaw’s Passage, Digbeth, Kilder is the craft beer, natural wine and cider bar by the team behind Original Patty Men.

Not content with slinging out some of the very best burgers in Brum (and probably the whole country), the guys from O.P.M. decided to add another string to their bow, in the form of an awesome bar tucked away under the railway arches behind Moor Street Station. This bar is all about high quality drinks and great vibes, and it might just be your new favourite watering hole.

On the menu at Kilder are all manner of great quality drinks from locally brewed craft beers to the tastiest natural wines and some seriously cool and dangerously drinkable cocktails, they have it all. They have 22 taps featuring a range of beers and ciders as well as some delicious cocktails (Cosmopolitan on tap? Yes, please! In fact, how do we get this installed in our house?) so there’s a great range of drinks to choose from. With the likes of Floradora (gin, lime, raspberry, ginger ale), Tommy’s Watermelon Margarita (tequila, lime, watermelon, Maldon salt) and Cosmopolitan (vodka, triple sec, lime, cranberry) on tap – there’s a small but big hitting selection of tasty cocktails to enjoy, as well as a couple of canned cocktails available too.

They also have a wide range of beers by the can and the bottle to choose from. So whether you like a lager, IPA or stout, there are lots of options to choose from, including a number of gluten free and alcohol free choices too. More of a wine fan? They have you covered there too with lots of carefully chosen natural wines available either by the glass or by the bottle. If you prefer cider they have lots of those by the bottle and can too, alongside a selection of spirits, soft drinks and more. You’ll be spoilt for choice.

At Kilder you can also tuck into some tasty grub while you enjoy your chosen drinks, thanks to their pizza concept ‘Corner Shop’ which runs every Wednesday and Saturday (remember you can also enjoy 10% off pizzas at Corner Shop with your IB App too). Tuck into some mouth-watering deep pan Detroit-style pizzas as you sip your nice cold beers, natural wines and tasty cocktails. Sounds perfect. There are bar snacks available at all times and quite often they have kitchen takeovers too. But if there’s no pop-up when you visit you can always pop next door for an epic burger from O.P.M (or order online and have your burger delivered to you in the bar).

The interior at Kilder is a wonderful mix of cosy and cool, with industrial touches reflecting the location under the railway arches, chic wall tiles and a mix of bar tables, trestle tables and booth style seating giving a choice of seating options for everyone. They’re dog friendly too, so you can bring your best furry friend along with you.

If you’re looking for a place to have a nice chilled drink, where the beverages are high quality and there just happens to be some tasty grub on offer too, then you’ve come to the right place. Get yourself down to Kilder to make all your dreams come true.

content.rendered:
Not all burgers are created equal.

Although there’s no shortage of great burgers to be found in Birmingham, variety is, as they say, the spice of life. So when we stumble upon yet another amazing burger place, we just have to let you all know.

Introducing Burger-Me-Up.

Located on Pershore Road, Stirchley, Burger-Me-Up is the independent burger joint making your wildest burger dreams come true.

We love a good burger. There’s nothing quite like sinking your teeth into a hand-smashed patty, smothered in cheese and sauces, and encased in a soft fluffy bun. It’s the ultimate indulgence. A naughty treat to satisfy those hunger pangs. It’s the best.

At Burger-Me-Up they’re all about delicious flavours and quality ingredients. All of their sauces are homemade which means that as well as the standard flavours, they can add some tasty and unique flavour combos too. They offer mouth-watering hand-smashed patty burgers as well as fried chicken burgers and some veggie/vegan options. They also offer the option to switch to a gluten free bun if you’d prefer.

On the menu at Burger-Me-Up are a good selection of both classic and creative flavours. As well as offering the likes of their Classic, BBQ Bacon Cheese and the Chicken-Me-Up, they also offer the Daredevil Beef (or Chicken!) featuring British Beef Patties (or chicken breast patty), Chorizo Rings, American Cheese, Shredded Lettuce, Jalapeños and Daredevil Sauce. But by far one of their most popular choices is the PB Jelly-Me-Up – British Beef Patties, American Cheese, Nan’s Raspberry Jam, Bacon and Onion Jam, and Crunchy Peanut Butter. Featuring raspberry jam made by co-owner Alex’s Nan, it sounds whacky but it really works! Don’t believe us? Go try it for yourself…

Making sure the veggies and vegans don’t just get the same boring options as usual, they’ve created some exciting meat-free options. There’s the BBQ Black Bean Burger (Homemade BBQ Black Bean Patty, House Slaw and BBQ Sauce in a Vegan Brioche Bun), and the Halloumi Burger (Grilled Halloumi, Shredded Lettuce, Caramelised Onion Chutney and Hot Honey). All sound super tasty!

Let’s talk sides. No trip to Burger-Me-Up would be complete without ordering some of their epic sides (the perfect accompaniment to your chosen burger, of course). If you like your sides classic, go for their fries. Whether you opt for seasoned fries or loaded fries (topped with their homemade cheese sauce, bacon bits and spring onions), both are utterly delicious. If you can’t choose between beef burger and chicken burger then might we suggest you order one of their amazing beef burgers and add a side of chicken strips – that way you get the best of both worlds!

But, in game changing news, Burger-Me-Up offers a taste of your childhood by offering the ultimate potato-based side too: smiley faces! Choose from seasoned or loaded smiley faces for the ultimate dose of nostalgia (but even better) and we’re pretty sure that they’ll put a big cheesy grin on your own face. Oh, the memories!

If all of that deliciousness wasn’t enough, Burger-Me-Up also offer seriously indulgent milkshakes. It can be hard to find a good shake sometimes (we’re always on the hunt), but they’ve absolutely nailed it and we can’t think of a better way to round off your meal than adding one of their creamy shakes. Choose from classic flavours like vanilla, chocolate and strawberry or go for one of their specials like Nutella, Biscoff, Maltesers or Peanut Butter. Whichever one you choose, you’ll be slurping away to your heart’s content. If shakes aren’t your thing, they offer an array of craft beers, cocktails, wines, soft drinks and more to slurp on instead.

The burger bar itself is fun and vibrant with their signature blue and pink branding throughout. This is a laid-back eatery where the focus is on the food. Fast food but taken to a whole new level.

So if you’re craving a burger (who isn’t?) then head on down to Stirchley and satisfy those cravings at the ace Burger-Me-Up! You had us at “Smiley Faces”…

content.rendered:
Great food, cosy vibes, delicious drinks, and mouth-watering pastries. This place has it all.

Introducing Oak Ca Phe.

Located on Bearwood Road, Oak Ca Phe is the Vietnamese coffee shop and restaurant bringing bold flavours and comfort food to Bearwood.

Oak Ca Phe is about more than just grabbing a bite to eat, it’s a place to meet and gather, to enjoy the little moments in life and to really savour some great food and delicious, authentic Vietnamese flavours. The owners have worked hard to create a calm and iniviting space that welcomes you in, and a menu packed full of secret family recipes.

Using a combination of traditional, family recipes from Vietnam and modern techniques, the team at Oak Ca Phe have created a menu packed with bold, vibrant flavours that’s both fresh and light, and warm and comforting. You’ll find loads of crowd-pleasing dishes on their menu that will leave you wanting to visit time and time again. Some of their signature dishes include Vietnamese favourites such as Banh Mi, Pho and more, as well as chicken wings, noodle bowls and squid and, of course, their delicious pastries and Vietnamese coffees.

Whether you’re stopping by for a quick coffee and a pastry, or you’re enjoying a leisurely lunch, this place has it all. The Vietnamese coffees are truly delicious, whether hot or iced – with lots of unique coffees to try, including egg coffee, coconut coffee and salted coffee. Plus their extravagant array of fresh pastries is heavenly – think huge fluffy croissants, decadent cruffins, moreish danishes, and you get the gist.

Alongside their coffees and pastries, they also offer an extensive menu of hot dishes including small plates, curries, noodle bowls and more. From Vietnamese favourites like Summer Rolls, Ca Ri (Vietnamese coconut curry), Pho and Bun Thit Noung (Vermicelli noodle bowl), to less traditional dishes like loaded fries, there are so many mouth-watering dishes to choose from – including plenty of veggie and vegan options too.

As well as their delicious food, they do of course have an excellent drinks menu too. We’ve mentioned their wonderful Vietnamese coffees, but they also offer a selection of teas and hot chocolate, as well as an array of lovely refreshing cold drinks too. From flavour-packed smoothies using exotic fruits to freshly squeezed juices (we can never resist a freshly squeezed orange juice when we see one), there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

The interior is casual chic, with lots of calming tones, houseplants and wooden accents giving nice tonal, relaxed vibes which perfectly complement the laid-back, welcoming atmosphere the owners have created. With a mix of bar seating for when you’re just stopping by and comfy chairs for when you want to relax, every corner of this cute coffee shop is both stylish and practical. Cosy and comfortable, this is a wonderful little spot in which to meet friends, grab a solo coffee, or enjoy a laid-back, highly delicious lunch. Your new favourite place to unwind.

content.rendered:
Foodie trends come and go, but a damn good steak will always be in fashion!

The folks at this premium steak restaurant whole heartedly agree with that sentiment and their aim is to deliver you the finest cuts of meat cooked to perfection so you can enjoy the perfect steak on every visit.

Introducing EN Steak.

Located in The Mailbox, EN Steak is the premium steak restaurant in the heart of the city centre.

This place is a true carnivore’s dream, so if you like to tuck into all things meaty then this is the restaurant for you. At EN Steak they take great pride in sourcing the finest cuts of meat. They source their high quality meats from award-winning farms in Herefordshire along with certified Japnese Wagyu from the finest cuts of Kobe beef. They only choose the very best cuts to ensure that every bite you take is bursting with flavour, tendernes and juiciness.

The steaks are obviously the main attraction at this establishment (it’s in the name after all!) and there are a number of cuts to choose from. You could opt for individual steaks (sirloin, fillet, rib-eye, rump) from the all-natural, grass-fed Hereford cattle (dry-aged for a minimum of 21 days) or for one of their luxuriously marbled Japanese steaks, or you could opt for one of the larger steaks which are perfect for sharing (or for if you’re just really hungry). All of the steaks are grilled over charcoal and cherry wood to give a delicate smokey flavour and served with your choice of butter.

To accompany your delicious meats cooked to perfection using the state-of-the-art charcoal ovens and dry-aging chambers, you can also enjoy some of the unique and flavourful side dishes designed to compliment those premium meats. Using locally sourced ingredients, the team at EN Steak have cooked up some classic sides such as confit potatoes, skin on chips and tomato salad. If you’re feeling a little more adventurous then why not opt for something different like their Thai noodle salad or a hearty mac and cheese to go with your steak instead.

Not only can you eat mouth-watering steaks and sumptuous side dishes, but there are alternative mains on the menu too. If you don’t fancy a steak then you can choose one of their other equally tasty mains instead, such as lamb rump, chicken supreme, a daily fish special or a tasty dry-aged burger. There’s also a grilled hispi cabbage option for veggies too. Whatever you choose, steak or main, you know that the chefs have sourced the best ingredients and your dish will be utterly delicious.

At EN Steak they know that the drinks matter just as much as the food, which is why they have put as much thought and care into their drinks list as they have their food menu. On the menu are a selection of delectable cocktails (both alcoholic and not) designed and mixed in-house, including some of their own signature drinks and a range of classics (Piña Colada, Clover Club, Whisky Sour and lots more). As well as these cocktails, there’s also a number of hand-selected wines, beers, soft drinks and more, so there’s a delicious drink to suit every palate.

The interior of EN Steak is as luxurious and beautiful as the ingredients they use in their dishes. From leather benches to cosy booths and rich hues, there are lots of details that compliment the decor with the food. This restaurant is perfectly suited to its water-front location in The Mailbox and is the perfect place for a date night, special celebration or just a very tasty mid-week meal.

How many times have you thought to yourself “I’m really craving an incredible plate of pasta” but not known where to go?

We’re talking proper pasta – freshly-made, hand-rolled, sauces and fillings made from scratch. The kind of pasta you’d expect to find in a little cafe in a small Italian town. The kind of pasta that would have you hopping on a plane just for one more mouthful. Well, the search is finally over. We have the answer to all of your pasta cravings (no airport necessary). You can thank us later.

Introducing Trentina.

Located on the corner of Caroline Street and Mary Street, Trentina is the pasta cafe bringing a slice of the Italian riviera to the streets of the Jewellery Quarter.

From the team behind the legendary Tiger Bites Pig and the seriously tasty Tierra (so you already know it’s going to be epic) comes a brand new independent restaurant serving up delicious, freshly-made pasta dishes and Italian small plates. Trentina is a love letter to all things Italian but with a British twist, and mamma mia, it is goooood.

Inspired by the incredible pasta dishes you find across Italy, Trentina’s menu is filled with a selection of small plates, pasta dishes and desserts using classic Italian flavours and techniques but made with outstanding local and British ingredients. They make all of their pasta, fillings and sauces themselves for maximum flavour and quality. The menu may change but you will always find their delicious take on classics such as Cacio E Pepe (trust us, this is insane), spinach, ricotta and duck egg ravioli (expect a deliciously runny egg yolk when you cut into this one), and rigatoni arrabbiata.

At Trentina they know that the best ingredients make the best dishes, so they have trawled the UK to find the highest quality ingredients from British producers who share their love of all things Italian. From the Cobble Lane cured meats for their charcuterie plate to the Dunwood Farm meat for their ragu, they have carefully chosen suppliers whose ethos aligns with theirs and who care about animal welfare, quality and sustainability.

The flour they use to make their pasta is organic and comes from Shipton Mill in the Cotswolds, who work tirelessly to preserve rare grains as well as using hydroelectricity to power their mill for a more eco-friendly product. Even the Stracciatella and Mozzarella they use at Trentina come from British dairy herds, for super fresh and tasty cheese. Whilst a few ingredients do have to be shipped from Italy, wherever possible they source their ingredients from closer to home, showcasing some incredible British farmers and producers.

If you’re still full after consuming your body weight in pasta and small plates (it’s the only way to consume pasta, after all) then Trentina also have a couple of insanely delicious dessert options. You could go for the classic Tiramisu (always a winner in our books) or opt for one of their soft serve options. Our pick has to be the soft serve Affogato (soft serve topped with a shot of Espresso and a biscuit) – the perfect pick-me-up to revive you from your food coma.

To compliment the incredible food, they have a selection of soft drinks, craft beers and house cocktails. Their cocktail menu is short but filled with crowd pleasers (think Negroni, Espresso Martini, G&T) and if you try one thing off the cocktail menu, it has to be the Limoncello Granita. As refreshing as it is delicious, this boozy little slushie will transport you straight to the Amalfi coast (not literally, that would be crazy).

Trentina is a neighbourhood cafe doing it right. The food is accessible, delicious and fresh. The drinks are tasty. The service is friendly. The interior at Trentina is minimal, with the marbled table tops, green cladding and exposed brickwork adding little details of style to this cafe-style space. The pared back interior just lets the food do the talking (and it has a lot to say – mostly about how tasty it is).

If you love pasta, then this place is a must. Come for pasta and cocktails, stay for delicious desserts and then come back again and again (trust us, you won’t be able to stay away).

Now offering Independent Birmingham Members: a FREE soft serve ice cream when you spend £10 or more (Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday)

content.rendered:
One of the most wonderful things about independent businesses is the story behind each one.

The individuals who have invested their life savings to fulfil their life-long dreams, the stories of starting from nothing to growing a successful and thriving business, the families who have run an independent through multiple generations, handing over their legacy as they go. These compelling stories are one of the things that make each business so unique and add a vibrancy to the patchwork of fascinating people and places throughout the city.

Introducing Chung Ying Cantonese Restaurant.

Located on Wrottesley Street in Birmingham’s Chinatown, Chung Ying Cantonese Restaurant is a fantastic restaurant that will need no introduction to many of you.

First established in 1981 by husband and wife, Siu Chung and Yuk Ying Wong, Chung Ying Cantonese is one of the longest-running and most authentic Cantonese restaurants in the city. Proudly run by the Wong family for 40 years (and counting), this incredible restaurant has stood the test of time as one of the longest running (and very best) independent restaurants in Birmingham.

Many of you will already be familiar with this award-winning restaurant, as it is one of the most popular and beloved restaurants in Brum. If, for some reason, you have never heard of them, let us fill in the blanks for you and introduce you to this amazing family-run restaurant.

One of the most successful Catonese restaurants in the city, Chung Ying Cantonese sits in the heart of Birmingham’s Chinatown, just across from the bustling Arcadian Centre and a short hop from another legendary independent, Birmingham Hippodrome. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite before catching a show, celebrating a special occasion, or just fancy a delicious Cantonese dinner, Chung Ying is the place to go.

The menu at Chung Ying Cantonese Restaurant is packed with delicious and authentic Cantonese dishes – the main feature of which is their unbelievably extensive (and mouth-watering) Dim Sum menu (seriously folks, this Dim Sum is unmissable). From delectable dumplings to spicy Sichuan dishes, mouth-watering fried rice to moreish noodles, there’s something for everyone.

Whether you like the classic take-away style dishes (think crispy shredded beef, sweet and sour, salt and chilli, black bean, and more), or you fancy trying some of the more traditional tastes (such as Braised Frog’s Legs with Bitter Melon in Black Bean Sauce, or Salted Fish with Minced Pork and Aubergine Casserole), the extensive menu is packed full of incredible dishes. But, if you order one thing and one thing only (which would be a total mistake, as the menu is jam-packed with smash hit after smash hit), we recommend the beautifully-fluffy steamed Char Siu Bao Buns.

At Chung Ying Cantonese, they’re proud to cater for lots of dietary requirements and the menu features a wide selection of unbelievably tasty vegetarian and vegan options. The team of highly experienced and knowledgable chefs use traditional cooking methods to incorporate all the flavours from Hong Kong throughout each dish, whether it’s a vegetarian delight, fresh seafood, or something meaty.

The restaurant itself is a comfortable and welcoming space, inviting guests of all ages to enjoy the atmosphere and, of course, the amazing food in this popular restaurant. At Chung Ying they have been delighting customers, new and established alike, for decades thanks to their incredible service and passion to be the best they can be.

Next time you’re looking for a delicious and authentic Chinese feast, there’s no better place than the incredible Chung Ying Cantonese Restaurant.

Now offering Independent Birmingham Members: 20% off the bill (Monday – Thursday: valid for up to 4 people)

content.rendered:
Flaky, buttery croissants. Crusty, warm baguettes. Deliciously decadent pastries. There’s no doubt about it, the French know how to bake.

When you’re dreaming of those incredible neighbourhood boulangeries and the baked delights to be found within, there’s only one place to go to satisfy those carb cravings.

Introducing Levain & Cherry.

Located on Kings Heath High Street, Levain & Cherry is the artisan French bakery making all of your baked goods dreams come true.

It’s no secret that we love baked goods, in all their forms. Quite simply, we believe there is nothing better than a slice of fresh bread, straight from the oven, slathered with butter. Baked goods in all their forms are the stuff of dreams. And if we could get away with it, we’d eat bread and pastries all day, every day.

At Levain & Cherry, they really know what they’re doing, and that’s why their baked goods are like little morsels from the gods themselves. If you’re as serious as us about bread and pastries and all the other delicious baked carby delights, then chances are you’ve probably already discovered Levain & Cherry. If not, allow us to make the necessary introductions (you can thank us later – preferably by sending us baked goods).

Inspired by his upbringing in France, founder Pascal wanted to bring a truly authentic French bakery experience to Birmingham, and we are all thanking him for it. Staying true to their authenticity, they only use French organic flours from Moulins Viron – a family-run flour mill found just outside Paris. The majority of the products in the bakery are made from Levain (sourdough), including their sourdough loaves, baguettes, focaccia, brioche and buns.

As well as their incredible array of freshly-baked breads available for you to stock up on at the bakery, they also bake fresh pastries every day too. Trust us when we say these are some of the very best pastries and treats you can get your hands on in Birmingham. From epic croissants and pain au chocolats, to heavenly cinnamon buns and marmite and cheddar swirls, there’s something for everyone. Look out for their specials too – taking inspiration from classic French flavours as well as from across the globe, they create some wonderfully original flavour combinations (such as french onion, black pudding, comte, parsley and truffle oil focaccia; n’duja and blue cheese cruffins; or chocolate pistachio and walnut babka).

As you walk down Kings Heath High Street, the smell alone will be enough to draw you inside (is there anything better than the smell of freshly-baked bread?), and once you step through the door you’ll be greeted by the glorious sight of the most incredible baked goods around. Stock up on all your favourites to take home and enjoy, and we guarantee it will make your day/week infinitely better.

If you’re looking to up your bread and pastry game by a factor of 1000, then we seriously recommend you head to Levain & Cherry. Foodie glory awaits!

Now offering Independent Birmingham Members: 10% off all purchases (Wednesday – Thursday)

content.rendered:
There isn’t much that we love more than a great coffee shop.

We could wax lyrical all day about how much we love that caffeine fix and how sometimes only an excellent flat white can save the most dire of days. But one thing we love even more than a great coffee shop, is a coffee shop that brings those immaculate vibes. And this place has vibes by the bucket load.

Introducing Boho Bakehouse.

Located on Station Road, Dorridge, Boho Bakehouse is the speciality coffee shop and luxury bakery where the aesthetics and the flavours go hand in hand.

Inspired by the laid-back coffee shops of South East Asia, and with their own boho vibes, this little neighbourhood coffee shop is the epitome of laid-back luxe. The perfect place to relax and enjoy a delicious speciality coffee (alongside a mouth-watering cupcake, of course), this cute and cosy coffee shop is perfect for meeting friends, enjoying a quiet solo moment, or grabbing a quick take-away cuppa on the way past.

Co-owner, Emily, is a self-taught baker with years of experience in the hospitality industry. Through her passion for baking she has supplied celebration cakes for friends and family and now bakes all of the cakes you can enjoy at Boho Bakehouse. The cakes are as pretty as they are tasty because Emily believes that the prettiest food tastes the best (and we can’t disagree when the cakes taste and look this good!).

Jack is the other co-owner and he’s in charge of coffee. He believes that good coffee brings good vibes – a sentiment we can whole-heartedly get behind. To help fulfil Emily’s dream of opening the bakehouse, he has turned his love of coffee into a full-time barista role, preparing delicious speciality coffees for customers. Both Emily and Jack are equally as passionate about making sure that customers leave with a smile on their face. There are, of course, alternative hot drinks including teas and hot chocolates available too, for the non coffee drinkers out there. Their hot chocolates are especially awesome, and a must order.

The counter at Boho Bakehouse is always stocked with a range of mouth-watering cupcakes that Emily has painstakingly crafted to make sure they’re as pretty as they are tasty. With a range of classic, signature and luxe flavours to choose from (including the likes of Vanilla and Strawberry, Lemon Drizzle, Oreo, Biscoff, Carrot and Pistachio Cheesecake, Dark Chocolate Ganache and loads more) there’s something for everyone. You can make up a box to take away with you and enjoy later (or just enjoy one in-house with a lovely coffee). As well as these cupcakes, you will also find a selection of cookies, brownies, rocky road and other baked goodies. The perfect little treat to brighten your day, you can also take home a mix-and-match box of these goodies too (for a little pick-me-up later on).

As well as the beautiful cakes and bakes they stock in store, you can also pre-order boxes of cupcakes and gorgeous celebration cakes too. Check out their website to discover the range of flavours and size options available and then order a cake for that big birthday or celebration and that’s one less thing to think about!

The neutral décor at Boho Bakehouse reflects the style of the brand and their rustic (but very pretty) cakes perfectly. With earthy, neutral tones throughout, this light, bright and airy coffee shop is calm and relaxing. The potted plants, rattan accessories and neon sign add little touches of fun and personality to the neutral space, which is both inviting and comfortable. With an outdoor seating area for when the weather is nice, this is the ideal place to enjoy a moment of relaxation in a busy day. Oh, and they’re dog friendly too!

So, if you’re looking for your next caffeine fix or a mouth-watering sweet treat (or both!), make sure you pop into Boho Bakehouse. The vibes are immaculate.
